WHAT IS MACFLY PRO?

MacFly Pro is a simple yet powerful Mac assistant that keeps an eye on your computer and ensures its well-being. The app cleans user and system caches, broken application data and media leftovers. MacFly Pro also handles duplicate files on your Mac and uninstalls rarely user apps. You don’t even have to think about all these things thanks to the Smart Assistant: it scans your Mac on a daily basis gathering all the needed fixes in one place.
